scope: Purposive audit, fixed before opening any selected raw context; all six labels, both literal cases, two differently structured figurative cases, one each associated/non_animal/uncertain/editorial. Not random, prevalence, agreement or error-rate estimation.
reviewer: Independent Codex agent; source/window audit, not human or specialist consensus

cases.rationale: The complete selected window includes A Dream: the Emmet speaks about her children, the glow-worm answers as watchman and directs her toward the beetle's sound. Personification directly supports animal_figurative under the recorded rule. The ending offers a route home; it does not narrate completed rescue.
cases.rival_reading: An ant's particular need and ordinary insect activities remain present within the personified scene. A figurative label does not erase that animal reference.
cases.needed_evidence: An image or edition claim would require separate original/copy inspection. No code change is justified by this window.
cases.reading_ceiling: Entire selected window; all twenty verse lines of this captured A Dream transcription appear within it. No full-copy or image credit.
cases.mode_resolution: figurative function supported; literal animal reference can coexist

cases.rationale: Honey of Bees is presented alongside milk and harvest produce. The matched name has a concrete animal/product sense, and the record expressly withholds an observed-natural-history claim.
cases.rival_reading: Albion's suffering body and transformed landscape give the whole sequence allegorical force. That does not by itself make the noun's local referent non-animal.
cases.needed_evidence: Further Jerusalem and copy/design reading would be needed for a wider account of the landscape. No species or empirical-behavior inference is supported.
cases.reading_ceiling: Complete bounded source window only; no whole-Jerusalem or image credit.
cases.mode_resolution: concrete animal sense supportable within the poetic/allegorical setting

cases.rationale: The honey bees sing in the Argument's transformed landscape. The wording alone does not decide between conventional buzzing-as-song and stronger personification; retaining uncertain is justified.
cases.rival_reading: Singing may be ordinary poetic description of bee sound, or an animal voice participating in the altered scene. Neither alternative is forced by the selected text.
cases.needed_evidence: A clearer declared boundary for mixed modes and specialist argument could refine the label; a modern taxon would not resolve the literary ambiguity.
cases.reading_ceiling: Complete selected window, including the entire Argument text present in it; no whole-book or image credit.
cases.mode_resolution: unresolved literal/figurative mode; existing uncertainty preserved

cases.rationale: The construction fowl that may fly makes the matched span a motion verb. It is not the name of an invertebrate, even though birds and other creatures occur nearby.
cases.rival_reading: The window is full of animal language, but the label concerns this matched span. The text is a captured Genesis transcription and must not become an undifferentiated claim about Blake's authored animal vocabulary.
cases.needed_evidence: No additional context is needed to refuse an invertebrate sense at this span. Broader authorship claims require separate source treatment.
cases.reading_ceiling: Complete selected Genesis source window only; no whole-manuscript, Bible or image credit.
cases.mode_resolution: non-animal lexical use at the matched span

cases.rationale: Silken modifies nets that Oothoon proposes to spread to catch girls. Material/capture imagery supports an associated lead; this span names neither silkworm nor spider.
cases.rival_reading: Silken can describe softness, seduction or material rather than an asserted animal product. The association is a search lead, not an adjudicated organism.
cases.needed_evidence: An animal-production or species claim would need explicit additional evidence. Wider interpretation must retain the coercive possibility of catching/trapping and the speaker's proposal.
cases.reading_ceiling: Complete selected Visions window only; no whole-work or image credit.
cases.mode_resolution: associated product/material/structure lead; no organism asserted

cases.rationale: Spiders' web-making belongs to the dungeon description. The concrete animal sense is compatible with the enclosing political scene, and the annotation does not assert a species or an observed dungeon.
cases.rival_reading: The tower named Order, grave comparison and neighboring emblematic prisoners make the setting figurative. A single mode cannot exhaust this passage's functions.
cases.needed_evidence: Original/design and broader work inspection would be needed for visual or comprehensive political claims. No reason to replace this local referent label emerges from the window.
cases.reading_ceiling: Complete selected French Revolution window only; no whole-work or image credit. Modern notes in raw XML were excluded from the primary reading.
cases.mode_resolution: concrete animal referent supportable within a figurative political scene

cases.rationale: The opening animal address immediately becomes reciprocal fly/man questions, followed by conditional claims about thought, life and death. That explicit comparison supports the protocol's figurative label.
cases.rival_reading: The addressed fly and the speaker's destructive hand retain a possible literal encounter. The ending may also recentre the speaker rather than establish the animal's cognition or welfare.
cases.needed_evidence: The selected transcription supports the code; cognition, animal consciousness and the force of the ending remain interpretive questions requiring argument, not a count.
cases.reading_ceiling: Entire selected window; all twenty verse lines of this captured The Fly transcription appear within it. No full-copy or image credit.
cases.mode_resolution: explicit comparison supported; literal encounter remains a live dimension

cases.rationale: The exact raw XML span lies in illusobjdesc describing birds flying above words, before the separate phystext verse. Editorial takes precedence under the declared authorship rule.
cases.rival_reading: If one considered lexical sense alone, fly is also a bird-motion verb. That does not justify promoting modern catalog expression into Blake's primary text.
cases.needed_evidence: Any claim about the depicted birds or a visual invertebrate would require inspecting the original object with its own rights/provenance record. No image was inspected here.
cases.reading_ceiling: Complete selected raw-XML window and element boundary only; no visual-object or verse-content reading credit from the catalog text.
cases.mode_resolution: modern editorial source boundary established; original source_role remains unverified

limits: Eight purposive existing decisions only. No count/label/source-role changes, accuracy estimate, representative agreement, whole-work/image/whole-oeuvre or scientific/release acceptance.
